chapter: Chicago, the Marable boats and Marge's St. Louis family band
title: Falling out with Charlie and deciding to go to Chicago
summary: After a disagreement and over Creath's objection, the newly married Singletons left for Chicago in a Model T; Zutty wanted bigger things and knew the New Orleans musicians there.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Well Zutty always had wanderlust, he always wanted to go to Chicago. A lot of the New Oreleans boys were there.
Yeah, but I mean how did you come to leave -- when you went to Chicago, you left Charlie, didn't you?
Yes.
But by this time you were married.
Yes.
A whirlwind courtship, huh?
The thing about -- see, old Charlie -- we had a little words about something.
Yeah.
And we decided to go to Chicago.
Yeah.

Then Charlie tried to stop us from going to Chicago, see, so we'd like for you to stay right here in St. Louis. Marge and I, we had made up our mind that we were going to Chicago, and we had a Model-T Ford, and --
Got in that --
And we got in that Ford --
Because Zutty wanted to travel, he didn't want to stay in St. Louis.
I see.
He wanted to come east, he wanted to -- you know what I mean, he was really looking for bigger and better things.
And also you'd heard about these other New Orleans guys up there.
Sure, yeah.
Yeah. Because see I'd been to Chicago before, you know.
And how did you go there before?
Before, working on the railroad.
